+class AwaitableOrContextManagerWrapper(Generic[SupportsAsyncCloseType]):
+    __slots__ = ("aw", "entered")
+
+    def __init__(self, aw: Awaitable[SupportsAsyncCloseType]) -> None:
+        self.aw = aw
+
+    def __await__(self) -> Generator[Any, None, SupportsAsyncCloseType]:
+        return self.aw.__await__()
+
+    async def __aenter__(self) -> SupportsAsyncCloseType:
+        self.entered = await self.aw
+        return self.entered
+
+    async def __aexit__(self, *args: Any) -> None:
+        await self.entered.close()

+def test_request_form_context_manager_closes_files(test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> None:
+    uploads: list[UploadFile] = []
+
+    async def app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
+        request = Request(scope, receive)
+        async with request.form() as form:
+            uploads.extend(value for value in form.values() if isinstance(value, UploadFile))
+            assert all(not upload.file.closed for upload in uploads)
+        response = Response()
+        await response(scope, receive, send)
+
+    client = test_client_factory(app)
+    response = client.post("/", files=[("first", ("first.txt", b"first")), ("second", ("second.txt", b"second"))])
+
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert len(uploads) == 2
+    assert all(upload.file.closed for upload in uploads)
+
+
+def test_request_form_context_manager_closes_files_on_error(test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> None:
+    uploads: list[UploadFile] = []
+
+    async def app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
+        request = Request(scope, receive)
+        async with request.form() as form:
+            upload = form["file"]
+            assert isinstance(upload, UploadFile)
+            uploads.append(upload)
+            raise RuntimeError("context failed")
+
+    client = test_client_factory(app)
